title: Dundes — Paired Motifemes (Slot / Filler Structure)
source: Alan Dundes, The Morphology of North American Indian Folktales (1964)
tier_note: Dundes applied Pike's emic/etic distinction to recast Propp's functions as 'motifemes' — structural SLOTS filled by interchangeable 'allomotifs'. The key insight for the generator: these come in tension→resolution PAIRS. `pairs_with` links each slot to its resolving slot; a well-formed beat sequence opens and later closes each pair.

items.name: Interdiction
items.description: A prohibition is laid down (do not do X).

items.name: Violation
items.description: The prohibition is broken, releasing consequence.

items.name: Lack
items.description: Something needed or desired is absent — the nuclear disequilibrium.

items.name: Lack Liquidated
items.description: The lack is remedied, restoring equilibrium.

items.name: Task
items.description: A difficult task or demand is imposed.

items.name: Deceit
items.description: A deceptive scheme is set in motion.

items.name: Deception
items.description: The deceit succeeds and its target is taken in.
